conversation:
olivia: Hey team — multiple customers pinging about missing "hours" on Console between ~02:00–06:00 UTC this morning. Charts show flat lines / zeros. Happened after last night's credential rotation.

natalie: Thanks, olivia. Can you paste one affected tenant_id and a screenshot or chart link? Also any correlation with other telemetry (ingest errors)?

olivia: tenant: tenant_acme_42
screenshot: https://redwood-internal/shared/console-screenshots/1768908888.png
Users saying their hourly usage is 0 for that window; previous and later hours look fine.

sam: I'm looking at the usage-ingest logs for that timeframe. Seeing auth failures from the ETL worker right after the rotation window (~01:58 UTC).

sam: log snippet:
```
2026-03-13T01:58:34Z ERROR usage-ingest-consumer tenant_acme_42: failed to fetch source data: 401 Unauthorized - service-account token invalid
2026-03-13T01:58:34Z WARN RetryableError: token refresh failed for service-account/ingest-sa
```

infra-bot: [AUTOMATED] service-account rotation completed: ingest-sa @ 2026-03-13T01:57:11Z — rotation_id=rot-20260313-03

mike: Frontend note: hourly rollups view doesn't fall back to raw events if rollups are missing; it just shows zeros. Query in analytics-api is simple:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) as tokens, hour
FROM hourly_rollups
WHERE tenant_id = 'tenant_acme_42' AND hour BETWEEN '2026-03-13T00:00Z' AND '2026-03-13T12:00Z'
GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
```
So missing rollup rows => zeros.

sam: Root cause is likely ETL workers continuing to use old SA key/token after rotation — they started returning 401s and then consumer crashed/restarted without reauthing properly.

natalie: OK. Plan: 1) rotate consumer credentials to the new key, 2) restart the consumer pods, 3) kick off backfill for the affected window for impacted tenants.

olivia: thumbs up. Can we prioritize customers who reported it while backfilling? ACME is one.

sam: Steps I'll run now:
- update K8s secret with new ingest-sa token
- rollout restart usage-ingest-consumer
- monitor logs for successful fetches

sam: kubectl commands (running in prod):
```
kubectl -n prod create secret generic ingest-sa-token --from-literal=token=<redacted> --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/usage-ingest-consumer
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=usage-ingest-consumer -f --tail=50
```

infra-bot: [ACTION] secret ingest-sa-token updated by sam at 2026-03-13T02:12:08Z

sam: Consumers came back up and are fetching successfully now — seeing fetch success logs:
```
2026-03-13T02:14:22Z INFO usage-ingest-consumer tenant_acme_42: fetched 720 events for hour=2026-03-13T02:00Z
```

natalie: Good. Next: backfill. I'm going to trigger the backfill DAG for tenant_acme_42 for 2026-03-13 02:00–06:00 UTC.

natalie: airflow trigger (running):
```
airflow dags trigger usage_hourly_backfill --conf '{"tenant_id":"tenant_acme_42","start":"2026-03-13T02:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-13T06:00:00Z"}'
```

natalie: Backfill started (dag run id=manual__2026-03-13T02:20:00). I'll watch the task logs.

mike: I'll patch frontend to show a small warning in the chart if rollups are missing: "Data gap detected — refreshing hourly rollups" so support can see it's transient. Low-risk UI change.

olivia: Please ping customers once we have confirmation rows present. I'll draft a short message.

natalie: Backfill tasks completed for tenant_acme_42, rows written for hours 02:00–06:00. SQL confirmation:
```
SELECT hour, count(*) FROM hourly_rollups WHERE tenant_id='tenant_acme_42' AND hour >= '2026-03-13T02:00Z' AND hour <= '2026-03-13T06:00Z' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
-- returns counts > 0 for each hour
```

natalie: Marking this as resolved for ACME. I'll continue monitoring other customer reports and kick off backfills where needed.

infra-bot: [AUTOMATED] deployment rollout succeeded: usage-ingest-consumer @ 2026-03-13T02:13:58Z
